edition.locus: Wine that puts drinkers to sleep for three days

source_text:
2.1 Πῶς δι' οἴνου κατεργάσαιτ'
ἄν τις τοὺς πεπωκότας πρὸς τὸ τρεῖς ἡμέρας κοιμᾶσθαι Ζηλωτὸς ὁ τοιούτου μὴ
λειπόμενος φαρμάκου· εἰ γὰρ εὐπορήσει οἶνον ἐκ τούτου σκευάζειν, κοιμῶνται μὲν
οἱ τούτῳ χρησάμενοι τῷ ποτῷ, ὡς καὶ καταληφθῆναι τοὺς πεπωκότας ὑπὸ τῶν
πολεμίων κοιμωμένους μέχρι τριῶν ἡμερῶν· ἀναστήσονται δὲ εἰ ὄξος χρίσοιτό τις
αὐτῶν τοὺς μυκτῆρας. Ἡ δὲ τούτου σκευασία ἐστὶν αὕτη· ὀπίου Θηβαϊκοῦ ὡς ἐν
θέματι μέρη βʹ· ταῦτα λειώσας μετὰ χυλοῦ ὑοσκυάμου μέρους ἑνὸς ῥύπον τε τὸν ἐξ
ὠτὸς ὄνου τοῦ δεξιοῦ λειώσας, ἔμβαλε τῷ οἴνῳ.
pass_a_gloss: How through wine one-might-work-upon those having-drunk toward the three days to-sleep. Enviable the of-such not being-left-without of-drug; for if he-will-have-means wine from this to-prepare, they-sleep the this having-used drink, so-as even to-be-caught the having-drunk under the enemies sleeping until of-three days; they-will-rise but if vinegar someone-should-anoint of-them the nostrils. The of-this preparation is this: of-opium Theban as in a-dose parts two; these having-pounded-smooth with of-juice of-henbane of-part one and dirt the from ear of-donkey the-right having-pounded-smooth, throw into-the wine.
pass_b_english: How through wine one might work upon those who have drunk, so they sleep for three days. Enviable is the man who is not without such a drug: for if he will have the means to prepare wine from this, those who have used this drink sleep, so that those who have drunk are even caught by the enemy sleeping up to three days. They will rise if someone should anoint their nostrils with vinegar.

The preparation of this is as follows. Two parts of Theban opium, as in a dose: pound these smooth with one part of henbane juice, and pound the dirt from the right ear of a donkey, and throw it into the wine.

choices.why: Predicate adjective: the man not lacking this drug is to be envied. Not the Zealots.
The waking antidote smeared on the nostrils; not a taste-word.

choices.english: the dirt from the ear of a donkey
choices.why: ῥύπος is dirt/filth; the lock specifies the right ear.
